items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Frank come got me one night, knocked on my door. He said, Frank, you got no job tonight. I said, where you playing?

ctx.x: Did Jimmy Noon have his own band, or did he play with somebody?

He was playing with different fellas, you know. Yeah. Around here one time, musicians make the best of the time. Yeah. My father come got me, Frank. Frank come got me one night, knocked on my door. He said, Frank, you got no job tonight. I said, where you playing? He played at the parlor. You know where the parlor park is? No. On the charter right corner from the church. I know, I know.
The parlor park. Near the St. Louis Cathedral?
